exact_claim: Let N>=1 and D_i be linear images of closed Euclidean unit balls of rank m_i>=2 in R^d. For D=sum_i D_i and Exp(D) the singleton exposed faces, the complex Zariski closure E of Exp(D) is irreducible. This removes the genericity condition of the exact upstream target. N=1, repeated discs, and lower-dimensional sums are included. The separate S extension is not needed for this target.
